# Psalm 54 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. To be accompanied by stringed instruments. A psalm of David, regarding the time the Ziphites came to Saul and said, 'We know where David is hiding.'

**2** Come with great power, O God, and rescue me! Defend me with Your might.

**3** Listen to my prayer, O God. Pay attention to my plea.

**4** For strangers are attacking me; violent people are trying to kill me. They care nothing for God. Pause and reflect.

**5** But God is my helper. The Lord keeps me alive!

**6** He will turn the evil plots of my enemies back on them. Do as You have promised and put an end to them.

**7** I will sacrifice a voluntary offering to You; I will praise Your name, LORD, for it is good.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **54:5**: The shortest, most direct confession of trust in the Psalter: 'God is my helper.' Five words that contain an entire theology.

— PNEUMA
